report:
## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (one suggestion below the threshold and eight inconclusive checklist items)
The PR is ready to merge: no reviewer found a defect at or above the important threshold, and no checklist item failed. Eight checklist items stayed inconclusive because their claims depend on the anthropic 2.8.0 SDK source, which the review did not have.
Rule applied: rule 6 — a finding below the threshold and INCONCLUSIVE items remain → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (1)

<details><summary>1 item</summary>

1. `docs/internal/agent/factory.md` line 82 says the anthropic 2.x SDK sends API version `2026-10-21`. Nothing in the repository defines or tests that version string, and the pinned literal will go stale when the SDK lock moves. (raised by 1/5 agents)

</details>

### ℹ️ Informational — Deferred
- VC-1: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — anthropic 2.8 SDK's AsyncAnthropic messages.create and messages.stream accept `output_config` as a keyword argument and serialize it into the request body as `output_config` [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:244]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim concerns anthropic 2.8.0 AsyncAnthropic messages.create/stream signatures. The item has no dependency_sources, and a Glob for **/anthropic/resources/messages/messages.py in the head view found nothing. The repo only shows the call site at llm.py:244, where payload["output_config"] = {"effort": request.effort}, so the SDK source is unread. I did not run an installed-package inspection such as inspect.signature(AsyncMessages.create).

  </details>

- VC-2: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — The anthropic 2.x AsyncAnthropic client accepts an httpx2.AsyncClient as `http_client`, as the tests pass one through AnthropicLlmService [tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  AnthropicLlmService.__init__ (src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:47-72) forwards http_client unchanged via **extra_client_kwargs into anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(**client_kwargs). The test (tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:79-80) passes httpx2.AsyncClient(transport=httpx2.MockTransport(handler)). Whether the anthropic 2.x SDK's _base_client.py isinstance check accepts httpx2.AsyncClient is a library question. The item has no dependency_sources and the views contain no vendored anthropic source, so I did not read the SDK's http_client type check. I did not run the test either.

  </details>

- VC-3: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — The anthropic 2.x SDK sends the API key as an `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header instead of `X-Api-Key` [changelog.d/390.changed.md:1]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim (changelog.d/390.changed.md:1) is about anthropic 2.8.0 runtime behavior. The item has no dependency_sources, and a Glob for **/anthropic/_client.py under the review directory (both views) found nothing, so the SDK's auth_headers source was not available. The repository views alone cannot show which header the SDK sends. Missing evidence: anthropic 2.8.0 _client.py (auth_headers / _bearer_auth vs _api_key_auth).

  </details>

- VC-4: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The 2.x SDK and the API version it sends reject any sampling temperature [changelog.d/390.changed.md:1]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Claim text at changelog.d/390.changed.md:1. No dependency_sources were supplied, and the anthropic SDK is not in the views; I read the repo's .venv install (anthropic-2.8.0.dist-info) only as a best-effort aid. In it, 'temperature' appears nowhere outside beta/ (grep count 0 in resources/messages/messages.py, types/message_create_params.py, and the whole package excluding beta). So messages.create has no temperature parameter and a call with temperature=0.5 would raise TypeError at the SDK. _constants.py:7 sets ANTHROPIC_API_VERSION = '2026-10-21'. However, whether the API at that version rejects a temperature is server behavior that SDK source cannot show. The claim is absolute ('any sampling temperature'), and extra_body could still pass one through the SDK. The SDK half is supported but the API-version half cannot be settled from source. Missing evidence: API server behavior or docs for version 2026-10-21; I did not run a live call.

  </details>

- VC-5: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The anthropic 2.x SDK sends API version `2026-10-21` (anthropic-version header), as factory.md states [docs/internal/agent/factory.md]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim depends on the default anthropic-version header in the installed anthropic 2.x SDK (_client.py). The review resolved no dependency_sources (engine-setup.json: "dependency_sources": []), and the repository views do not vendor the SDK. A Grep for 2026-10-21 and anthropic-version across the head view only hit the factory.md claim text; a Grep for 2026-10-21 in any **/anthropic/_client.py on the filesystem found nothing. No SDK source was available to read, so the header value is unverified. Not run: inspecting the installed anthropic package's _client.py or a wire-level request capture.

  </details>

- VC-8: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The SSE events and message JSON in _sse()/_MESSAGE match the shapes the anthropic 2.8 SDK parses for messages streaming and create [tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim depends on how the anthropic 2.8 SDK parses SSE and message JSON. The item has no dependency_sources, and the head and base views do not contain the SDK (no committed vendor/). The only copy I found is a .venv in the working tree, which I may not use as a fallback. The test helpers _MESSAGE and _sse() are at tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:45-77. I did not compare them with lib/streaming/_messages.py or types/message.py. Missing evidence: the installed anthropic 2.8.0 source supplied through dependency_sources.

  </details>

- VC-10: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — anthropic exposes `__version__` starting with '2.' and probe_llm builds the real client with an API key without network I/O or error [tests/unit/test_preflight.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Repo side verified: pyproject.toml:34 pins anthropic>=2.8,<3, so __version__ starting with '2.' follows from the pin. probe_llm (src/sqllens/preflight.py:163-185) returns early if api_key is None, otherwise constructs AnthropicLlmService(model, api_key) and only catches anthropic.AnthropicError. AnthropicLlmService.__init__ (src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:47-72) only resolves env fallbacks and calls anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(**client_kwargs), with no request sent. Not settled: the item has no dependency_sources, and anthropic is not in the views, so I could not read AsyncAnthropic.__init__ or _version.py from an approved location. I therefore cannot confirm from source that construction does no network I/O and raises no error. I did not run the test or import the library.

  </details>

- VC-14: INCONCLUSIVE (critical) — `test_real_sdk_stream_retains_signature_and_tool_input` and `test_real_sdk_create_retains_signature_and_tool_input` in `tests/unit/test_opus_history.py` run the locked 2.x SDK against a mock HTTP transport and pass. Their assertions on `provider_content`, `content`, `finish_reason`, `usage` and tool calls are unchanged. [tests/unit/test_opus_history.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Graded with criteria.json (valid list; criterion 3 present). Verified: the diff hunks for tests/unit/test_opus_history.py (diff.patch lines 615-654) change only httpx -> httpx2 (import, Request/Response types, AsyncClient, MockTransport) in both test_real_sdk_* tests; no assertion lines on provider_content, content, finish_reason, usage or tool calls are touched, so 'assertions unchanged' holds. Head requirements.txt pins anthropic==2.8.0 (line 23) and httpx2==2.16.0 (line 50). AnthropicLlmService builds anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(**kwargs) forwarding http_client (llm.py:66-72). Not established: that the tests actually pass. That needs running `pytest tests/unit/test_opus_history.py` against the locked anthropic 2.8.0 and httpx2 2.16.0, which I did not run. No dependency_sources were supplied, so I could not read the SDK to confirm that it accepts an httpx2.AsyncClient and that the MockTransport SSE and JSON responses parse. No criterion trigger condition is involved.

  </details>

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #370 — criteria from the workpad; scope narrowed: 0 deferred, 1 rewritten, 0 not in the workpad. Requirement-based checklist items are listed under `## Code Review Findings` and `## Run details`.
Criteria came from the `/prflow:implement` workpad comment — this run's authoritative set, possibly narrowed from the issue.
- Rewritten by this run: `requirements.txt` pins anthropic to a 2.x release at or above 2.8. Its header's regeneration command still carries `--constraints <(echo 'sqlglot<30.30')`. `pytest -q tests/unit/test_lockfile_guard.py` passes, which asserts that each runtime dependency in `pyproject.toml` is pinned in `requirements.txt` at a version inside its declared range. → `requirements.txt` pins anthropic to a 2.x release at or above 2.8, and sqlglot stays at its locked 30.31.0 (the header's regeneration command carries no sqlglot constraint, which commit ec3c67f removed after #372). `pytest -q tests/unit/test_lockfile_guard.py` passes, which asserts that each runtime dependency in `pyproject.toml` is pinned in `requirements.txt` at a version inside its declared range.
Confirm the narrowed work was filed as a follow-up issue before merging.

  - VC-9: test_serve_rejects_toml_temperature_before_starting patches `sqllens.server.run`, the function `sqllens serve` calls to start a server [tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py]
  - VC-11: requirements.txt pins anthropic==2.8.0 and removes distro, consistent with anthropic 2.8.0's dependency set; httpx2 is resolvable for the dev extras [requirements.txt]
  - VC-12: `pyproject.toml` declares the anthropic dependency as `anthropic>=2.8,<3`, and its `dev` extras declare `httpx2`. [pyproject.toml:34]
  - VC-13: `requirements.txt` pins anthropic to a 2.x release at or above 2.8, and sqlglot stays at its locked 30.31.0 (the header's regeneration command carries no sqlglot constraint, which commit ec3c67f removed after #372). `pytest -q tests/unit/test_lockfile_guard.py` passes, which asserts that each runtime dependency in `pyproject.toml` is pinned in `requirements.txt` at a version inside its declared range. [requirements.txt]

A test asserts this on the body the mock transport captures, not on a stubbed `messages` object. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:244]
  - VC-16: `sqllens validate -c <path>` exits with code 2 and prints a message that names `temperature` and tells the operator to remove it, for each of these inputs, at minimum: TOML `temperature = 0.2`, TOML `temperature = 0.0`, TOML `temperature = 3`, TOML `temperature = "low"`, and `SQLLENS_LLM__TEMPERATURE=0.2` with no TOML key. `sqllens serve` with the TOML `temperature = 0.2` config exits with code 2 before it starts a server. With `temperature` unset, `sqllens validate` prints `Config OK` and exits 0. [src/sqllens/config.py:175]
  - VC-17: `LlmRequest` and `AgentConfig` declare no `temperature` field, `LLMAsJudgeEvaluator.__init__` has no `temperature` parameter, and no payload `AnthropicLlmService._build_payload` returns contains a `temperature` key. [src/sqllens/agent/core/llm/models.py]
  - VC-18: `probe_llm` still raises `PreflightError` with subsystem `"llm"` when building `AnthropicLlmService` raises an `anthropic.AnthropicError`, and `probe_llm` with a configured API key returns without error when it builds the real 2.x client. [tests/unit/test_preflight.py]
  - VC-19: `git grep -n -e 'anthropic>=0.49'` returns no line, so no comment or doc still gives the old 0.49 floor as a reason. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py]
  - VC-20: `docs/external/configuration.md`'s `[llm]` table states that `temperature` is no longer accepted and that a config that sets it fails to load. `docs/internal/agent/factory.md` states that `temperature` is rejected at config load and that no request carries it. The config template that `sqllens init` writes has no `temperature` line. [docs/external/configuration.md]
  - VC-21: A `changelog.d/<PR>.<category>.md` fragment for this change states each of these: SQL Lens now requires the anthropic 2.x SDK; `[llm] temperature`, added earlier in this unreleased cycle, is no longer accepted and a config that sets it fails to load; the 2.x SDK sends the API key as `Authorization: Bearer`; SQL Lens has no setting to send the key as `X-Api-Key`; and a gateway behind `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` that reads only `X-Api-Key` should be changed to read the `Authorization` header. [changelog.d/390.changed.md:1]
  - VC-22: The change adds no SQL Lens setting for the API key header or for extra request headers, so with a configured API key SQL Lens leaves the 2.x SDK's `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header in place. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:66-72]
  - VC-23: The change leaves `changelog.d/+legacy-004.added.md` unchanged, so the next release's notes still list `llm.temperature` as added, next to this change's fragment saying it is no longer accepted. [changelog.d/+legacy-004.added.md:1]

  </details>

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `pyproject.toml` declares the anthropic dependency as `anthropic>=2.8,<3`, and its `dev` extras declare `httpx2`.
- [ ] `requirements.txt` pins anthropic to a 2.x release at or above 2.8, and sqlglot stays at its locked 30.31.0 (the header's regeneration command carries no sqlglot constraint, which commit ec3c67f removed after #372). `pytest -q tests/unit/test_lockfile_guard.py` passes, which asserts that each runtime dependency in `pyproject.toml` is pinned in `requirements.txt` at a version inside its declared range.
- [ ] `test_real_sdk_stream_retains_signature_and_tool_input` and `test_real_sdk_create_retains_signature_and_tool_input` in `tests/unit/test_opus_history.py` run the locked 2.x SDK against a mock HTTP transport and pass. Their assertions on `provider_content`, `content`, `finish_reason`, `usage` and tool calls are unchanged.
- [ ] With `[llm] effort = "high"`, the HTTP request body that the locked 2.x SDK sends from both `send_request` and `stream_request` contains `"output_config": {"effort": "high"}` and no `temperature` key. A test asserts this on the body the mock transport captures, not on a stubbed `messages` object.
- [ ] `sqllens validate -c <path>` exits with code 2 and prints a message that names `temperature` and tells the operator to remove it, for each of these inputs, at minimum: TOML `temperature = 0.2`, TOML `temperature = 0.0`, TOML `temperature = 3`, TOML `temperature = "low"`, and `SQLLENS_LLM__TEMPERATURE=0.2` with no TOML key. `sqllens serve` with the TOML `temperature = 0.2` config exits with code 2 before it starts a server. With `temperature` unset, `sqllens validate` prints `Config OK` and exits 0.
- [ ] `LlmRequest` and `AgentConfig` declare no `temperature` field, `LLMAsJudgeEvaluator.__init__` has no `temperature` parameter, and no payload `AnthropicLlmService._build_payload` returns contains a `temperature` key.
- [ ] `probe_llm` still raises `PreflightError` with subsystem `"llm"` when building `AnthropicLlmService` raises an `anthropic.AnthropicError`, and `probe_llm` with a configured API key returns without error when it builds the real 2.x client.
- [ ] `git grep -n -e 'anthropic>=0.49'` returns no line, so no comment or doc still gives the old 0.49 floor as a reason.
- [ ] `docs/external/configuration.md`'s `[llm]` table states that `temperature` is no longer accepted and that a config that sets it fails to load. `docs/internal/agent/factory.md` states that `temperature` is rejected at config load and that no request carries it. The config template that `sqllens init` writes has no `temperature` line.
- [ ] A `changelog.d/<PR>.<category>.md` fragment for this change states each of these: SQL Lens now requires the anthropic 2.x SDK; `[llm] temperature`, added earlier in this unreleased cycle, is no longer accepted and a config that sets it fails to load; the 2.x SDK sends the API key as `Authorization: Bearer`; SQL Lens has no setting to send the key as `X-Api-Key`; and a gateway behind `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` that reads only `X-Api-Key` should be changed to read the `Authorization` header.
- [ ] The change adds no SQL Lens setting for the API key header or for extra request headers, so with a configured API key SQL Lens leaves the 2.x SDK's `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header in place.
- [ ] The change leaves `changelog.d/+legacy-004.added.md` unchanged, so the next release's notes still list `llm.temperature` as added, next to this change's fragment saying it is no longer accepted.
